subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers keep requiring inspectable Google Chat app-auth proof for this external PR, or accept the contributor's narrative production confirmation as sufficient?
rationale: The code review has concrete blockers, but the proof gate is a maintainer-controlled merge policy choice because the current evidence is not an inspectable live artifact.

options.title: Require Inspectable Proof
options.body: Keep the proof blocker until the contributor attaches redacted logs, terminal output, screenshots, recordings, or a linked artifact showing the app-auth link fallback after upload 403.

options.title: Waive Proof Deliberately
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the narrative production confirmation, but the code findings and conflict still need repair before merge.

options.title: Switch Canonical PR
options.body: Maintainers can pause or close this branch if a refreshed overlapping implementation becomes the chosen canonical fix for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Require Inspectable Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof blocker until the contributor attaches redacted logs, terminal output, screenshots, recordings, or a linked artifact showing the app-auth link fallback after upload 403.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent Google Chat API history and is the strongest routing candidate among the likely owners for the proof and canonical-implementation choice.
